content.value: Card: 'RedPajama is a clean-room, fully open-source implementation of the LLaMa dataset.' Token counts on the card: CommonCrawl 878B, C4 175B, GitHub 59B, ArXiv 28B, Wikipedia 24B, StackExchange 20B; total 1.2 trillion. Primarily English. The card says it 'was created to follow the LLaMa paper as closely as possible to try to reproduce its recipe.'
content.note: The 'Data-1T' name and the 1.2T total on the card differ; both are the card's.
